tools.name: list_recent_capabilities
tools.description: List the most recent CapabilityWire events (SDKs, MCP servers, models, tools, libraries). Optionally filter by category or a since timestamp.

tools.name: get_capability
tools.description: Fetch a single capability event by id or slug.

tools.name: search_capabilities
tools.description: Full-text-ish search over capability titles / summaries / tags. Returns up to `limit` matches.

tools.name: mark_seen
tools.description: Mark a capability event as delivered to the calling subscriber. Records a delivery for analytics.
